derivation: from H657 (אֶפֶס) and the plural of H1818 (דָּם); boundary of blood-drops;

occurrences.text: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes–dammim.
